nodes.summary: For every natural number $M \ge 1$ there is a natural number $K$ such that every finite Sidon set $A$ of natural numbers with at least $K$ elements has at least $M$ isolated elements in its sumset $A + A = \{x + y : x, y \in A\}$. nodes.title: Large Sidon sets have many isolated sums

nodes.summary: A finite set $A$ of natural numbers is a Sidon set when $a + b = c + d$ with $a, b, c, d \in A$ implies $\{a, b\} = \{c, d\}$, and its sumset is $A + A = \{x + y : x, y \in A\}$. An element $s$ of a finite set $S$ of natural numbers is isolated in $S$ when $s + 1 \notin S$ and either $s = 0$ or $s - 1 \notin S$. nodes.title: Erdős Problem 152 on isolated sums of Sidon sets

nodes.summary: Let $S$ be a finite set of natural numbers. A natural number $a$ is isolated in $S$ when $a \in S$, $a + 1 \notin S$, and either $a = 0$ or $a - 1 \notin S$.
nodes.title: Isolated elements of a set of natural numbers

nodes.summary: A finite set $A$ of natural numbers is a Sidon set when every equality $a + b = c + d$ with $a, b, c, d \in A$ is trivial, that is, $a = c$ and $b = d$, or $a = d$ and $b = c$.
nodes.title: Finite Sidon sets of natural numbers

nodes.summary: A set in an additive commutative monoid is Sidon when every equality of two pairwise sums is trivial up to swapping the summands. Repeated summands are included.
nodes.title: Sidon set

nodes.summary: For a finite set $S$ of natural numbers, the isolated count of $S$ is the number of elements $a \in S$ with $a + 1 \notin S$ and either $a = 0$ or $a - 1 \notin S$.
nodes.title: Number of isolated elements

nodes.summary: For a finite set $A$ of natural numbers, the sumset $A + A$ is the finite set of all sums $x + y$ with $x, y \in A$.
nodes.title: Sumset of a finite set of natural numbers

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
